crossRefs.note: Take away my disgrace that I dread, for your ordinances are good.

translations.web: lest one who hears it put you to shame, and your bad reputation never depart.
translations.bsb: lest the one who hears may disgrace you, and your infamy never go away.
translations.kjv: Lest he that heareth it put thee to shame, and thine infamy turn not away.
translations.asv: Lest he that heareth it revile thee, And thine infamy turn not away.
